summary: Prenetics Global Limited filed a Form 6-K announcing the appointment of Caroline Levy to its Board of Directors as an independent director, effective August 17, 2026, and as a member of the Audit, Compensation, and Nominating and Corporate Governance Committees, replacing Dr. Darshan Shah on those committees. Dr. Shah remains on the Board. The appointment is routine and not forced or abrupt. The filing includes a press release and is incorporated by reference into existing registration statements. No deal terms, prices, or strategic changes are stated. This event is routine, but the category 'Management Changes' is used as the filing's sole purpose is a board appointment.
